text_block_list.text:
Today, I came to a karaoke lounge with 
Eishin Flash and Tosen Jordan to practice 
dancing.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Step back half a pace with the left leg 
here, and point six seconds later, switch 
legs...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
And from here, I twist my upper body, spin 
270 degrees, and strike a pose...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoa, whoa, hold on a sec, Flash-san! 
You're totally overthinking the details!"

"...Today's goal is to overcome Eishin 
Flash's stiffness in dancing. Tosen Jordan 
is our collaborator."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, when it comes to dancing, isn't the 
groove and feeling way more important?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Vibes and feelings, is it...? Hmm... That 
may certainly be true, but for me, it is a 
bit difficult to—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well, it'll be fine, it'll be fine. If you 
just dance along to a catchy song, before 
you know it, you'll be totally into the 
groove.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Is that how it works, I wonder... In that 
case, what kind of song should I start 
with—
choice_data_list: ...First, let me show you how it's done!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Is that how it works, I wonder... In that 
case, what kind of song should I start 
with—
choice_data_list: ...First, let me show you how it's done!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good, sounds good! If the song 
doesn't have a set choreography, we just 
gotta feel the vibe.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...I see. That certainly sounds reasonable 
to me.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Then... practice is the only way!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Hm-hm, hmmm♪ Hm—hm-hm, hmm...♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ooh, nice, nice! Keep that momentum going♪

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. However, the rhythm 
for the pre-chorus here is quite 
unique—Hm, hmm...♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No way, it totally rocks! It's making me 
wanna dance already!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Hm-hm-hmm♪ Tra-la-la~♪ Woohoo~♪ 
Flash-san, you're the best♪

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Hum hum humm—♪ Hum hum hum humm, hum hum 
humm—♪ Next comes the chorus...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm-hm♪ Hmm-hm, hm-hmmm♪ Hm-hm-hm, 
hm-hm-hmm—♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ohh, nice! Keep it up~♪

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I see... So this is—! What they call 
"getting into the groove"...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Trainer, would you like to join 
me...!

—And after the three of them danced their 
hearts out... the stiffness in Eishin 
Flash's dancing had vanished before anyone 
realized.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
A role model...? Ah, me? Well, I don't 
know if I can show you anything that 
impressive, but...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Well, might as well give it a shot! 
Alright, keep your eyes on my dance!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Reach out your hand~♪ And grab even more 
glory~♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for num~ber~ one~♪ Let's challenge 
ourselves☆ Accel~er~ating~ awaaay~♪ 
Te-te-te-te, te-te~♪

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...It's strange. I can clearly tell she is 
singing from the bottom of her heart, but 
beyond that—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—It just looked so fun. Almost making me 
want to join in without thinking—
choice_data_list: In that case, why don't you try dancing?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I'm not sure if I can pull it off, 
but... I'll try to just go with the flow 
too.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat over whether you do it well or 
not! As long as it's fun, that's what 
counts♪ My choreography is pretty 
haphazard anyway♪

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Run through it all♪ On your very own 
path—♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Nice, that's the spirit! Keep loosening up 
and get into the groove♪

"...Afterward, Eishin Flash gradually 
relaxed and seemed to conquer her weakness 
in dancing!"
